name: Web Admin
description: Sets up the administration side of a site: adds the admin theme and everyday admin tools, pre-configured for a clean admin UI on install.
project_description:
Web Admin sets up the administration side of a site. It adds the admin theme and the everyday admin tools, and configures them so site builders and editors get a clean admin UI right after install.

 Included tools:

 Command & discovery: Coffee, Project Browser, Automatic Updates.
 Bulk operations: Views Bulk Operations, Views Bulk Edit, Masquerade.
 Form enhancements: Simple Add More, Tagify, View Password, Drupical.
 Core administration modules: Field UI, Views UI, Database Logging, Content Moderation, with admin blocks pre-configured.

 Dashboards are not part of Web Admin; they are available separately through the Web Dashboard recipe module.
